class User < ApplicationRecord
  include Authoring, Role, Transferable

  has_many :sessions, dependent: :destroy
  has_secure_password validations: false

  has_many :books, through: :accesses

    self == Current.user
  end

  def deactivate
    transaction do
      sessions.delete_all
      update! active: false, email_address: deactived_email_address
    end
  end

  def erase
    transaction do
      # Collect all email addresses associated with this user (original + deactivated)
      email_addresses = [email_address]
      if active?
        email_addresses << deactived_email_address
      end

      # Delete sessions
      sessions.delete_all

      # Delete sign-in events for all associated email addresses
      SignInEvent.where(email_address: email_addresses).delete_all

      # Delete reading marks
      reading_marks.delete_all

      # Delete accesses
      accesses.delete_all

      # Handle books created by this user
      created_books.find_each do |book|
        if book.everyone_access?
          # Keep the book but remove the creator attribution
          book.update!(creator_id: nil, author: "Deleted author")
        else
          # Delete private books
          book.destroy
        end
      end

      # Delete the user record
      destroy
    end
  end

  private
